audit.whatIsWrong: loading, report[8].t and report[10].t call Janna 'his'/'him'. Janna is female per champ-gender authority (and the deterministic lint agrees).
audit.why: The owner is addressed as 'you'; a third-person pronoun refers to the enemy, so a misgendered enemy reads as a wrong-champion template leak.
audit.corrected: Swapped his->her in all three fields.

audit.whatIsWrong: 'Gathering Fire haste' (whys[3], mid, spikes[3].text) is not a Karma ability or passive — Karma's kit has no haste-granting effect by that name; her only passive is Mantra cooldown reduction from damaging abilities.
audit.why: Naming a nonexistent mechanic as a reason Karma wins the lane misleads a player looking for a real source of the advantage.
audit.corrected: Replaced 'Gathering Fire haste' with the real driver — sustained Mantra-Q uptime.

audit.why: The all-Karma level chart is consistent with the kit: Janna has no lane damage (E is a pure shield, R is disengage/heal), so Karma's Q poke leads every stage — matches the 48.6% enemy winrate and FAVOURED diff.

audit.whatIsWrong: missingInteractions flags that Monsoon (R) sustains Janna through chip damage and Grievous Wounds timing decides extended trades. report[8].t already tells the player to add anti-heal, but no field states the mechanism (Monsoon's heal-over-time).
audit.why: Knowing anti-heal matters is less useful than knowing which spell needs it and when.
audit.corrected: Left as a note — report[]  is out of the mandatory sweep and the existing itemization line already carries the actionable instruction, so no further edit was added to avoid over-scoping the report array.
